title: Analysis code for a four-gene expression signature (AQP3, GGT5, ISLR, LAD1) in human heart failure
description: R code, derived tables and figure-generating scripts for a multi-omics analysis of human heart failure: differential expression in GSE57338, WGCNA, three-method machine-learning feature selection, logistic nomogram models, immune deconvolution and cell-composition adjustment, external validation in three independent cohorts (GSE5406, GSE116250, GSE55296), single-nucleus RNA-seq localisation of the four genes (GSE292067), cell-cell communication analysis, and two-sample Mendelian randomisation against the HERMES heart failure GWAS. Every module writes vector PDF and 600 dpi PNG figures, tabular outputs and sessionInfo provenance files.
notes: Raw public data (GEO, GWAS Catalog GCST009541, eQTLGen, GTEx v8, Ensembl) are not redistributed; download instructions are in docs/CODE_AVAILABILITY.md.
